events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

I’ll build the scene directly in a single inline HTML file, using layered CSS and canvas rendering for the bowl, ingredients, steam, glow, and mouse-responsive parallax. I’ll also include a reduced-motion path so the atmosphere stays calm when requested.

The page is now in place as a self-contained canvas scene: warm broth glow, layered ceramic bowl, noodles and toppings, animated steam, subtle floor shadow, and eased pointer movement. I’m doing a quick structural check for the single-file/no-external-assets constraints and script integrity.

Created the responsive, self-contained ramen hero scene in [index.html](<WORKSPACE>/openai/gpt-5.6-luna/low/index.html).

- Mouse-responsive parallax

- No UI, text, menus, or external assets
